stage_name: Optional Full Ecosystem Capability Packs — Web Search, Verified Camera, Private-LAN Home Assistant, Read-Only OAuth PKCE & TLS/Argon2id Remote Gateway (B26)

completed_work_packages.title: Optional Full Ecosystem Capability Packs with Per-Connector Consent, Threat Guards & Offline Degradation
highlights: WebSearchProviderPort (`SearxngWebSearchProvider`): per-connector consent persisted in `ecosystem_connector`, upfront DNS anti-SSRF + redirect refusal + streaming byte cap, private PII query guard, pre/post-unescape HTML & boundary-tag sanitization (`[ESCAPED_TAG]`), `BR-15` session tainting, and labeled stale cache offline degradation.

Home Assistant Private-LAN Client (`PrivateLanHomeAssistantClient`): enforces private LAN/RFC1918/loopback HTTPS only, OS Credential Vault token isolation (0 plaintext in SQLite), R3 safety-critical device bans, real `POST /api/services` + `GET /api/states` readback with honest `unavailable`/`unknown` outcomes and 0 blind retries.

Windows On-Demand Camera Adapter (`WindowsOnDemandCameraAdapter`): isolated in `jarvis.platform.windows` (NFR-16 kept), non-invasive PnP discovery without opening video streams, canonical `cam-<index>` validation, RAM-only bytearray capture with immediate close, and honest `UNSUPPORTED` refusal without synthetic dummy frames.

Read-Only OAuth 2.0 PKCE Calendar/Email Connector (`FR-LIF-04`): RFC 7636 S256 PKCE, RFC 8252 loopback redirect, strict read-only scope allowlist enforced on BOTH request and token-endpoint response, single-use CSRF state nonce, vault-only token storage, deduplicated `external_read` calendar import, `BR-15` session tainting, offline cached degradation, and instant vault wipe on revoke.

TLS-Hardened Remote Mobile Gateway (`FR-REM-01..04`, `NFR-11`): real local ECDSA P-256 X.509 cert provisioning pinned to private/VPN IP SANs with SHA-256 fingerprint verification gating production activation, salted Argon2id pairing-code hashing with 5-attempt lockout, and `RemoteReplayGuard` (`X-Jarvis-Nonce` + `X-Jarvis-Timestamp` +-60s window).
Frontend `EcosystemPanel` expanded with Opt-In Ecosystem Capability Packs consent/offline status & instant revocation control.

untested_surfaces: Live third-party cloud OAuth 2.0 providers (Google/Microsoft) with real browser loopback callback and live internet connectivity (automated suite uses deterministic httpx.MockTransport + injected DNS resolver).
Live physical webcam frame capture via optional opencv-python-headless on physical camera hardware.
Live Home Assistant LAN server over physical network TLS with real smart-home devices.
Live mobile companion TLS handshake over physical Tailscale/WireGuard VPN against running uvicorn TLS listener.

Remaining hardware/release-gate surfaces inherited from G0-G6: real human spoken audio WER corpus across noisy rooms, live multi-step GGUF GPU soak/latency under VRAM pressure, clean Windows VM installer smoke, and 8-hour soak test (NFR-12).
